Pure C# service that recognises Notion-style markdown shortcut patterns typed at the beginning of a block line. Call Detect after the user presses Space or Enter, passing the full plain-text content of the current block including the trigger character. Matching is prefix-based, so the text after the trigger is returned in TextAfterTrigger. Recognised prefixes, most specific first: "### ", "## ", "# ", "- [x] ", "- [ ] ", "[x] ", "[ ] ", "[] ", "* ", "- ", "> ", plus any digits followed by ". " for a numbered list. The exact tokens "```" and "---" (Enter) become a Code block and a Divider. FromJsShortcutKey and IsCheckedTodo bridge the shortcut keys emitted by notion-editor.js to the C# type system.

items.description: Async undo / redo history for a single Notion editor instance. Not a DI service — TmNotionPage creates one instance per page and cascades it to child components via CascadingValue so each page has its own isolated stack. items.description: Parses a CommonMark / GFM Markdown string into an ordered list of IPageBlock objects. Supports headings, paragraphs, bullet lists, numbered lists, task lists, blockquotes, fenced code blocks, horizontal rules, images, block equations, GFM tables and inline formatting. A table becomes one BlockType.Table block plus child BlockType.TableRow blocks whose ParentBlockId points at it — the same shape TmNotionTableBlock loads at runtime. Editor for a person database cell, showing an avatar with initials and the assigned person's name (or an unassigned placeholder), edited via a text input.

Read-only display of a relation database cell, rendering linked record ids as chips or a no-linked-records placeholder.
Read-only display of a computed rollup database cell, rendering the aggregated value as text or a placeholder.
Editor for a single-select database cell, showing the chosen option as a colored chip and, when editing, a searchable popup to pick one option or clear it.
